en-UK.name: Beilu Live
en-UK.description: Live stream danmaku into the chat context.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Live** connects to a live streaming room, screens incoming danmaku with deterministic rules (blacklist / cooldown / dedup / length), and feeds the selected ones into the existing main chat pipeline. No second generation chain — the main line handles api / preset / memory / prompt / streaming as before.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 直播设计
zh-CN.description: 直播弹幕接入：算法初筛后注入对话上下文
zh-CN.description_markdown: **直播设计** 连接直播间弹幕，经确定性规则初筛（黑名单/冷却/去重/长度），把选中的弹幕拼成上下文交给既有主对话链。不新建生成链——api/预设/记忆/提示词/流式渲染全部复用原有能力。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
